name: ai-test-management-hub
description: A lightweight, AI-assisted test management app: test cases, runs with evidence, JUnit/Playwright import, dashboards and human-reviewed AI suggestions.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c gray,blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @hub/shared" "npm run dev -w @hub/api" "npm run dev -w @hub/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @hub/shared && npm run build -w @hub/api && npm run build -w @hub/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @hub/shared && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:api
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
